title: Design Skiplist
sourceKind: third-party mirrors via web search (official page not fetchable)
summary: Design a skiplist with search(target), add(num) and erase(num) (erase returns false when absent) that runs in O(log n) time without built-in sorted containers.
officialConstraints: 0 <= num, target <= 2 * 10^4; at most 5 * 10^4 calls to search, add and erase.
visualizationNotes: Constraints came from a search snippet, not the official page. The example call sequence was written for this visualization and is not an official example. Duplicate handling is not confirmed by the official text: the mirror says removing any one copy is fine. The visualization accepts up to 40 calls and uses a deterministic level rule so the Python solution is reproducible.
